quotes.text: This was my first ever fishing charter, and my fiancé’s 30th birthday – he has always dreamt of catching a salmon in the Pacific. Our friends and I booked Stout Fish on recommendation and we can’t sing captain Steve’s praises enough.

Steve is a great fishing guide! He put us right on the fish and coached us on reeling them in. We all caught our limit and it was the most enjoyable charter any of us had ever been on. Steve is a great captain.
We had a great time fishing with steve. None of knew what we were doing so Steve did all the work he was very respectful and a great guy!
Captain Steve put us on fish. Couldn’t have asked for a better trip and can’t wait to go again!
We went fishing with Steve and he was great. Steve was awesome.
